description: Search what this node's deskVerify keeps; a read, nothing is written. over "tests": the latest state of each test (its newest row), answering {suite, title, outcome, commit, at, failure} per item, filtered by suite (file name), test (words graded against the title; a title they do not touch is left out), outcome (red or green), commit (a hash prefix), item (the tests of that item's listed suites) and since (an ISO time; rows at or after it). over "runs": each check it made, answering {kind, id, state, commit, queued, started, ended, outcome, line}, filtered by item, kind (item, red, goal, full), commit and since (queued at or after it). Every key but over is optional; a filter that does not belong to over is ignored. Answers {items: [{key, label: the row as json}], more}, newest first, bucket-bounded: more true means the answer is partial, so narrow the filters.
